hints.title: Sieve Index Computation
hints.text: Identify prime indices up to array length using a standard boolean primality sieve.

hints.title: Boundary Partitioning
hints.text: Begin a new segment whenever the current index is a prime number.

hints.title: Subarray List Assembly
hints.text: Append non-empty running segments into the result collection.

hints.title: Reference Implementation

complexity.notes: Sieve precomputation over indices followed by single linear pass segment generation.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Individual trial division at each index introduces extra logarithmic factors.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: Boolean array of size N marks prime indices for constant time checks.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Use sieve of Eratosthenes to identify prime index boundaries.
